requirements.title: E and D descriptor widths, fractional digits, exponent digits, and input e effect
requirements.definition: E w.d, D w.d, and E w.d E e occupy w positions except w=0 selects output width; fractional part has d digits unless scale factor greater than one; positive e fixes exponent digits and otherwise the minimum is used; e has no input effect.

pending.E-D-field-width: Internal WRITE(buf,'(SS,E9.2E2)') 1.0 expects exactly buf=' 0.10E+01' after E editing ownership; D output letter alternatives remain separate latitude.
pending.E-D-fractional-digits: Internal WRITE(buf,'(SS,E9.2E2)') 1.0 expects exactly two fractional digits in ' 0.10E+01'.
pending.E-D-e-no-input-effect: Internal READ('1E+1','(E4.0E2)') and READ('1E+1','(E4.0)') should both approximate 10.0; only e differs.

requirements.title: Table 13.1 enumerates E and D exponent forms
requirements.definition: Table 13.1 gives the row-by-row permitted exponent forms for E and D output, including E w.d, E w.d E e, E0.d, D w.d, and D0.d cases and the rule for z digits, s minimum digits, and zero exponent plus sign.

pending.table13_1_E_w_d_abs_le_99: Unassertable as one exact string for this row: Table 13.1 permits either E±z1z2 or ±0z1z2 for E w.d with w>0 and |exp|<=99. Use the E w.d E e row for byte-exact E output.
pending.table13_1_E_w_d_abs_100_to_999: Unassertable as a portable byte-exact plan in this packet: the row requires an exponent magnitude at least 100, which depends on an available real kind/range, and the table form itself omits the E letter.
pending.table13_1_E_w_d_Ee_positive: Row checked visually: E w.d E e with e>0 and |exp|<=10**e-1 uses E±z1...ze; internal WRITE(buf,'(SS,E9.2E2)') 1.0 expects exactly ' 0.10E+01'.
pending.table13_1_E_E0_or_E0_d: Row checked visually: E w.d E0 or E0.d uses E±z1...zs with minimum exponent digits. Internal WRITE(buf,'(SS,E0.2E0)') 1.0 to character(len=7) expects exactly buf='0.10E+1'.
pending.table13_1_D_w_d_abs_le_99: Unassertable as one exact string: Table 13.1 permits D±z1z2, E±z1z2, or ±0z1z2 for this D row; the exponent-letter choice is latitude.
pending.table13_1_D_w_d_abs_100_to_999: Unassertable as a portable byte-exact plan in this packet: the row requires exponent magnitude at least 100 and permits the sign-plus-digits form without a D/E letter.
pending.table13_1_D0_d_any: Unassertable as one exact string: Table 13.1 permits either D±z1...zs or E±z1...zs for D0.d; the D/E letter choice is latitude.
pending.table13_1_zero_exponent_plus: Row footnote checked visually: a plus sign is produced if exponent value is zero; internal WRITE(buf,'(SS,E9.2E2)') 0.5 expects exactly buf=' 0.50E+00'.

requirements.title: Scale factor controls E/D decimal normalization and permitted k range
requirements.definition: Scale factor k controls E/D decimal normalization: for -d<k<=0, exactly |k| leading zeros and d-|k| significant digits follow the decimal symbol; for 0<k<d+2, exactly k significant digits precede it and d-k+1 follow; other k values are not permitted.

pending.E-D-scale-negative-to-zero-normalization: After 13.8.6 scale-factor ownership, internal WRITE(buf,'(SS,-1P,E10.3E2)') 1.0 to character(len=10) expects exactly buf=' 0.010E+02'; k=-1 gives one leading zero after the decimal symbol and two significant fractional digits.
pending.E-D-scale-positive-normalization: After 13.8.6 scale-factor ownership, internal WRITE(buf,'(SS,1P,E10.3E2)') 1.0 to character(len=10) expects exactly buf=' 1.000E+00'; k=1 gives one significant digit to the left of the decimal symbol and three fractional digits.
pending.E-D-scale-factor-range: Source-control only: a format with k outside the permitted interval changes only scale factor; no diagnostic facet is filed for this unnumbered restriction.

review_rationale: Independent fresh-context source review, three rounds: doc/source_audits/batch_137.json. The reviewer re-derived unit hashes and read Tables 13.1, 13.2 and 13.3 ROW BY ROW against the PDF, independently of the author's reconstruction - necessary because extraction interleaved the columns and every future E/EN/ES fixture derives from those rows. THREE blocking findings. The integrator found the first directly: two sample plans gave a NEGATIVE result for the POSITIVE input 0.5, but SS suppresses the optional plus so the sign position must be BLANK - corrected to ' 500.000E-03' and '   5.000E-01', hand-derived and corroborated with gfortran. C137SR-001: ELEVEN units mixing an obligation with a grant of latitude were dispositioned wholly as permission - the fourth occurrence of that class this session - and were re-dispositioned to requirements with the latitude confined to rationale and oracle text; the reviewer confirmed no latitude is now wrongly asserted as an obligation. C137SR-002: placeholder plans remained, saying things like 'future plan must include exact output'; 48 entries were changed, 21 upgraded to exact executable strings and 27 marked explicitly unassertable, and the reviewer independently derived the scale-factor cases -1P,E10.3E2 giving ' 0.010E+02' and 1P,E10.3E2 giving ' 1.000E+00'. R1323 carries no diagnostic facet because it defines a hex-digit-string form and prohibits nothing. Source accounting only: authored_facets unchanged at 1977.
